Garage Sale

Posted on November 11, 2021

Garage Sale, Feb 18-19, 2022

Our Annual Cornwallis Neighborhood Garage Sale will take place February 18-19, 2022.
To get your permit please visit http://garagesale.capecoral.net and don’t forget to print it. It is free and must be displayed. So start cleaning out those closets and garages. We will be advertising the garage sale in The Breeze, Nextdoor Cornwallis, The Marketplace, Offer Up and Craig’s List.

Good Luck!
